### EPS CALCULATION 


### For calibration curve

This chunk is to make the Glucose standard curve with the controls I used during the Anthrone assay. I flagged them with the "Morphology" "Calibration" to be able to filter them out.
After creating the calibration curve I will find the linear model (ax + b = y, where y is the Glucose, and x is the OD620) to estimate the amount of Glucose produced by each single strain. The Anthrone experiment calculated the OD620, therefore that is the number that I have. 

```{r}

Oct2025_AnthroneOD620 <- read_excel("~/OneDrive - The Pennsylvania State University/Burghardt Lab Shared Folder/Projects/NIFA-AVT-AlfalfaProjects/Aim1bAVT_StrainCollection/Chapter1_Partners_Mariale/Experiments/EPS measurement/Data_Input/06_20_25_EPS/Oct2025_AnthroneOD620.xlsx", sheet = 1) ## Open the file with the OD620 data
#View(Oct2025_AnthroneOD620)

Glucose_standards <- Oct2025_AnthroneOD620 %>% filter(Morphology == "Calibration")## Filter Morphology > Calibration 
#View(Calibration)

# I prepared the calibrations using a determined amount of glucose and then diluted it. The stock of the glucose concentration was 1mg/ml. For the Glu1, I diluted 923.1 ul in 15 mL, so the aliquote that is used for the Anthone assay (325 ul) contains 20 ug. Each number represents "ug". I will add the glucose concentration creating first a new column. This is according to the way I have prepared the dilutions 

Glucose_standards <- Glucose_standards %>%
  mutate(Glucose_quantity = case_when(
    Strain == "Glu1" ~ 20, #ug
    Strain == "Glu2" ~ 10, #ug
    Strain == "Glu3" ~ 5, #ug
    Strain == "Glu4" ~ 2.5, #ug
    Strain == "Glu5" ~ 1.25, #ug
    Strain == "Glu6" ~ 0.625, #ug
    Strain == "Glu7" ~ 0.3125, #ug
    Strain == "Glu8" ~ 0.15625, #ug
    TRUE ~ NA_real_  # Default case if no match is found
  ))

ggplot(Glucose_standards, aes(OD620_Adj, Glucose_quantity)) +
  geom_point() + geom_smooth(method = "lm")

## I will extract the coefficients to make a formula and apply that to my current values 
#View(Glucose_quantity)
model <- lm(Glucose_quantity ~ OD620_Adj, data= Glucose_standards) ## OD620 Adj was obtained by calculating the mean of the Blanks and substracting the OD620 values of the strains minus the blanks. 
summary(model)
## For an "ax + b" type of model.     
coefficients <- coef(model)

b_intercept <- coefficients["(Intercept)"]
b_intercept #  -0.3255626 
a_slope <- coefficients["OD620_Adj"]
a_slope #

### Calculating the glucose for everything: y = ax + b

## I will use the formula to modify the real values

## Filter out the Blank and the ones that have Glu but are not useful for the calibration

Oct2025_AnthroneOD620 <- Oct2025_AnthroneOD620 %>% filter(!(Strain == "Bla" | grepl("Glu", Strain)))
#View(Oct2025_AnthroneOD620)
                                                          
OD620_strains <- Oct2025_AnthroneOD620 %>% 
  mutate(Glucose_quantity = a_slope*OD620_Adj + b_intercept)
#View(OD620_strains)


OD600 <- read_excel("~/OneDrive - The Pennsylvania State University/Burghardt Lab Shared Folder/Projects/NIFA-AVT-AlfalfaProjects/Aim1bAVT_StrainCollection/Chapter1_Partners_Mariale/Experiments/EPS measurement/Data_Input/06_20_25_EPS/Oct2025_AnthroneOD620.xlsx", sheet = 2)
#View(OD600)

## I have two small reps per strain so I will find the mean 

OD600_ave <- OD600 %>%
  group_by(Name) %>%
  summarise(OD600_ave = mean(OD600_Adj)) ## OD600_Adj is the value of the raw OD600 minuts the values of the OD600 of the blanks

#View(OD600_ave)

## I am going to merge both tables by 

Anthrone <- merge(OD620_strains, OD600_ave, by = "Name")
#View(Anthrone)

Anthrone <- Anthrone %>%
  mutate(
    Strain = as.character(Strain),
    Name   = as.character(Name)
  )
#View(Anthrone)
Anthrone <- Anthrone %>%
  mutate(Glucose_OD600 = Glucose_quantity/OD600_ave) ## This value is the normalized glucose. We have normalized the EPS production (OD620) by the biomass (OD600). 
View(Anthrone)

Anthrone_complete <- Anthrone %>% filter(Name != "112.3") ## Clean-up remove this from original file.## Maybe this is Data_input

## Make sure the name of the strains are characters

write_xlsx(Anthrone_complete, here("Tables", "Anthrone_complete.xlsx"))

Anthrone_complete  <- read_excel(here("Tables", "Anthrone_complete.xlsx"))
#View(Anthrone_complete)

Anthrone_mean <- Anthrone_complete %>%
  group_by(Strain, Morphology) %>%
  summarise(Glucose_OD600_ave = mean(Glucose_OD600))

#View(Anthrone_mean)
write_xlsx(Anthrone_mean, here("Tables", "Anthrone_mean.csv"))




#### Anthrone per pair

I am trying to assess whether the mucoid bacteria always have more EPS than the dry bacteria in the same co-occurring pair to justify the "Mucoid" and "Dry" assignment that was given to them in the beginnig

```{r}

### I have a total of 19 pairs in this particular isolation and I want to know if the classified as "dry" has less EPS than the classified as "mucoid" 

## Pairs


Strains_used <- read_excel("~/OneDrive - The Pennsylvania State University/Burghardt Lab Shared Folder/Projects/NIFA-AVT-AlfalfaProjects/Aim1bAVT_StrainCollection/Chapter1_Partners_Mariale/Analysis/Strains_Description_Phenotype.xlsx", sheet = 1) ## Move this file to 

Strain_used_pair <- Strains_used %>% filter(!is.na(Pairs)) %>% select(-"Morphology") ## Subset the strains that have a pair for this analysis and filter out Morphology column so it doesn't get duplicated when we do the "Anthrone_complete"
#View(Strain_used_pair)
#View(Anthrone_complete)
Strain_used_pair <- Strain_used_pair %>%
  mutate(Pair_strain = paste0(Pairs, "_", Strain))
#View(Strain_used_pair)

Pair_Anthrone_complete <- left_join(Strain_used_pair, Anthrone_complete, by = "Strain") 
#View(Pair_Anthrone_complete)


color_initial_values <- c("Dry" = "#e0ba3e",
                  "Mucoid" = "#4eadb9")

Pair_Anthrone_complete$Pairs <- factor(Pair_Anthrone_complete$Pairs)


Pairs_anthrone <- ggplot(Pair_Anthrone_complete, aes(x = Pairs, y = Glucose_OD600, color = Morphology)) +
  geom_jitter() +
  geom_line(aes(group = Pairs)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_initial_values) +
  theme_minimal() +
    labs(
    x = "Pairs",
    y = "OD620/OD600") +
  coord_flip()

Pairs_anthrone


ggsave(Pairs_anthrone, file = here("Figures/FigureS2_FromR.pdf"), width = 10, height = 10, units = "in")


## Statistics

model1_raw <- lmer(Glucose_OD600 ~ Morphology + (1|Pairs), data = Pair_Anthrone_complete) ## This analysis is done in the file that works with only the Pairs
model1_raw
anova1 <- anova(model1_raw)
anova1
anova1 <- rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(anova1), var = "Term")
anova1
colnames(anova1)

anova_TableS1 <- anova1 %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & !matches("^Df$"), ~ sprintf("%.3f", .))) %>%
  mutate(`Pr(>F)` = ifelse(as.numeric(`Pr(>F)`) < 0.001, "< 0.001", `Pr(>F)`)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-`Mean Sq`, - NumDF, - DenDF)
anova_TableS1

write_xlsx(anova_TableS1, here("Tables", "TableS1_FromR.xlsx"))

```

### Rhizobial fitness in single inoculation experiments: Single vs mucoid 

These results show that Mucoid strains have a higher absolute fitness than dry bacteria in the single inoculation experiments but not through having higher density in the nodules. 

#### Soil mesocosm survival 

Arrange the file that I can use for the rest of the code 

```{r}

### Survival ###

Survival_Mesocosm <- read_excel("/Users/mariaalejandragilpolo/OneDrive - The Pennsylvania State University/Burghardt Lab Shared Folder/Projects/NIFA-AVT-AlfalfaProjects/Aim1bAVT_StrainCollection/Chapter1_Partners_Mariale/Experiments/Mesocosms/Mesocosm_survival/Data_input_Mesocosm_survival.xlsx", sheet=2)

Survival_Mesocosm <- Survival_Mesocosm %>%

    Treatment == "4"  ~ "4 °C",
    Treatment == "22" ~ "22 °C",
    TRUE ~ Treatment
  ))

Survival_Mesocosm <- Survival_Mesocosm %>% filter(!is.na(Volume_ul)) #Filtering out the ones that were not assessed
Survival_Mesocosm <- Survival_Mesocosm %>% filter(Rep_tube != "s") #Filtering out the "sacrificed" plants that I counted to assess what dilutions should I plate 

Survival_Mesocosm$Colonies_Dry <- as.numeric(Survival_Mesocosm$Colonies_Dry)
Survival_Mesocosm$Colonies_Mucoid <- as.numeric(Survival_Mesocosm$Colonies_Mucoid)
Survival_Mesocosm$Dilution <- as.numeric(Survival_Mesocosm$Dilution)
Survival_Mesocosm$Volume_ul <- as.numeric(Survival_Mesocosm$Volume_ul)

Survival_Mesocosm <- Survival_Mesocosm %>%

    Dry_CFU_Total = Colonies_Dry*10^5*10^(Dilution -1)/Volume_ul,

    Percentage_Dry_ave  = mean(Percentage_Dry,  na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

### Edit the timepoint 0

The drought received the same amount of cells than the other treatments in less volume because it was a less concentrated sample. But in the original files I have only wrote the timepoint 0.

```{r}

### Survival

expand_survival_baseline <- function(data, morphology_value) {
  
  dat_morph <- data %>%
    filter(Morphology == morphology_value)
  
  dat_no_initial <- dat_morph %>%
    filter(Timepoint != "0")
  
  initial_baseline <- dat_morph %>%
    filter(Timepoint == "0")
  
  treatments_to_add <- dat_no_initial %>%
    distinct(Treatment) %>%
    pull(Treatment) %>%
    unique()
  
  baseline_rows <- purrr::map_dfr(
    treatments_to_add,
    ~ initial_baseline %>%
      mutate(Treatment = .x, Timepoint = "0")
  )
  
  expanded <- bind_rows(baseline_rows, dat_no_initial) %>%
    mutate(Log10Total = log10(Total_CFU_ave))
  
  return(expanded)
}

Survival_Mesocoms_Mucoid_ave.expanded  <- expand_survival_baseline(Survival_Mesocoms_ave, "Mucoid")
Survival_Mesocoms_Dry_ave.expanded     <- expand_survival_baseline(Survival_Mesocoms_ave, "Dry")
Survival_Mesocoms_Mixture_ave.expanded <- expand_survival_baseline(Survival_Mesocoms_ave, "Mixture")


Survival_Mesocosm.expanded <- rbind(Survival_Mesocoms_Mucoid_ave.expanded, Survival_Mesocoms_Dry_ave.expanded, Survival_Mesocoms_Mixture_ave.expanded)

#View(Survival_Mesocosm.expanded)
## Add the symbol for centigrad 



popsize.median_Survival <- Survival_Mesocosm.expanded %>% 
  group_by(Timepoint, Treatment, Morphology) %>% 
  summarise(
    median = median(Log10Total, na.rm = TRUE),
    min    = min(Log10Total, na.rm = TRUE),
    max    = max(Log10Total, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

popsize.median_Survival

expand_growth_baseline <- function(data, morphology_value) {
  
  dat_morph <- data %>%
    filter(Morphology == morphology_value)
  
  dat_no_initial <- dat_morph %>%
    filter(Timepoint != "0")
  
  initial_baseline <- dat_morph %>%
    filter(Timepoint == "0")
  
  treatments_to_add <- dat_no_initial %>%
    distinct(Treatment) %>%
    pull(Treatment) %>%
    unique()
  
  baseline_rows <- purrr::map_dfr(
    treatments_to_add,
    ~ initial_baseline %>%
      mutate(Treatment = .x, Timepoint = "0")
  )
  
  expanded <- bind_rows(baseline_rows, dat_no_initial) %>%
    mutate(Log10Total = log10(Total_CFU_ave))
  
  return(expanded)
}

Growth_Mesocoms_Mucoid_ave.expanded  <- expand_growth_baseline(Growth_Mesocoms_ave, "Mucoid")
Growth_Mesocoms_Dry_ave.expanded     <- expand_growth_baseline(Growth_Mesocoms_ave, "Dry")
Growth_Mesocoms_Mixture_ave.expanded <- expand_growth_baseline(Growth_Mesocoms_ave, "Mixture")


### Bringing both Survival and Growth together:

Growth_Mesocosm.expanded <- rbind(Growth_Mesocoms_Mucoid_ave.expanded, Growth_Mesocoms_Dry_ave.expanded, Growth_Mesocoms_Mixture_ave.expanded)

#View(Growth_Mesocosm.expanded)



### Calculate the median for the population size

popsize.median_Growth<- Growth_Mesocosm.expanded %>%
  group_by(Timepoint, Treatment, Morphology) %>% 
  summarise(
    median = median(Log10Total, na.rm = TRUE),
    min    = min(Log10Total, na.rm = TRUE),
    max    = max(Log10Total, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


popsize.median_Survival$Condition <- "Survival"
popsize.median_Growth$Condition <- "Growth"

popsize.median_Survival <- popsize.median_Survival %>%
  mutate(
    Condition  = "Survival",
    Timepoint  = factor(Timepoint,
                        levels = c("0", "3 months", "6 months", "12 months"))  
  )

popsize.median_Growth <- popsize.median_Growth %>%
  mutate(
    Condition  = "Growth",
    Timepoint  = factor(Timepoint,
                        levels = c("0", "7 days", "14 days", "21 days", "42 days", "60 days"))  
  )
popsize.median_All <- dplyr::bind_rows(popsize.median_Survival,
                                       popsize.median_Growth)

#View(popsize.median_All)

### Run statistical tests. Which has higher fitness in the soil. 

## The statistical analysis will be with the Log10. 

#Survival_Mesocosm has the original not averaged values of Survival experiment

Survival_Mesocoms_ave <- Survival_Mesocoms_ave %>% filter(Morphology %in% c("Mucoid", "Dry")) %>% filter(Timepoint != "0")
m_Survival <- lm(log10(Total_CFU_ave) ~ Morphology * Timepoint * Treatment, data = Survival_Mesocoms_ave)
anova_Survival <- anova(m_Survival)
anova_Survival

aov_Survival_FullModel_table <- rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(anova_Survival), var = "Term")
aov_Survival_FullModel_table

aov_Survival_FullModel_table <- aov_Survival_FullModel_table %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & !matches("^Df$"), ~ sprintf("%.3f", .))) %>%
  mutate(`Pr(>F)` = ifelse(as.numeric(`Pr(>F)`) < 0.001, "< 0.001", `Pr(>F)`)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-`Mean Sq`)

aov_Survival_FullModel_table

write_xlsx(aov_Survival_FullModel_table, here("Tables", "aov_Survival_FullModel_table.xlsx"))

### Now analyze within each
emm_Survival <- emmeans(m_Survival, ~ Morphology | Treatment * Timepoint)
emm_Survival

diffs_Survival <- pairs(emm_Survival, adjust = "holm")
diffs_Survival

plotdf_Survival <- as.data.frame(confint(diffs_Survival)) #This converts the reuslts in a dataframe. 
plotdf_Survival
plotdf_Survival$Timepoint <- factor(plotdf_Survival$Timepoint,
  levels = c("3 months", "6 months", "1 year")
)

## Safe this file first. 
diffs_Survival_dataframe <- as.data.frame(diffs_Survival)
#View(diffs_Survival_dataframe)

diff_Survival_dataframe <- diffs_Survival_dataframe %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & !matches("^Df$"), ~ sprintf("%.3f", .))) %>%
  mutate(`p.value` = ifelse(as.numeric(`p.value`) < 0.001, "< 0.001", `p.value`)) 

diff_Survival_dataframe

write_xlsx(diff_Survival_dataframe, here("Tables", "diff_Survival_dataframe.xlsx"))




## Growth


Growth_Mesocoms_ave <- Growth_Mesocoms_ave %>% filter(Morphology %in% c("Mucoid", "Dry")) %>% filter(Timepoint != "0") %>% filter(Treatment != "4")
Growth_Mesocoms_ave <- Growth_Mesocoms_ave %>%
  filter(!is.na(Total_CFU_ave), Total_CFU_ave > 0) ## Having a 0 as the Total_CFU_ave is problematic in downstream analysis because of log10(0)

#str(Growth_Mesocoms_ave$Total_CFU_ave)

#View(Growth_Mesocoms_ave)
m_Growth <- lm(log10(Total_CFU_ave) ~ Morphology * Timepoint * Treatment, data = Growth_Mesocoms_ave)
anova_Growth <- anova(m_Growth)

### Safe the full model 

aov_Growth_FullModel_table <- rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(anova_Growth), var = "Term")
aov_Growth_FullModel_table

aov_Growth_FullModel_table <- aov_Growth_FullModel_table %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & !matches("^Df$"), ~ sprintf("%.3f", .))) %>%
  mutate(`Pr(>F)` = ifelse(as.numeric(`Pr(>F)`) < 0.001, "< 0.001", `Pr(>F)`)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-`Mean Sq`)

write_xlsx(aov_Growth_FullModel_table, here("Tables", "aov_Growth_FullModel_table.xlsx"))



### Now analyze within each
emm_Growth <- emmeans(m_Growth, ~ Morphology | Treatment * Timepoint)
emm_Growth

diffs_Growth <- pairs(emm_Growth, adjust = "holm")
diffs_Growth

plotdf_Growth <- as.data.frame(confint(diffs_Growth)) #This converts the reuslts in a dataframe. 
plotdf_Growth
plotdf_Growth$Timepoint <- factor(plotdf_Growth$Timepoint,
  levels = c("7 days", "14 days", "21 days", "42 days", "60 days")
)

## Safe this file first. 
diffs_Growth_dataframe <- as.data.frame(diffs_Growth)

diff_Growth_dataframe <- diffs_Growth_dataframe %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & !matches("^Df$"), ~ sprintf("%.3f", .))) %>%
  mutate(`p.value` = ifelse(as.numeric(`p.value`) < 0.001, "< 0.001", `p.value`)) 

diff_Growth_dataframe

write_xlsx(diff_Growth_dataframe, here("Tables", "diff_Growth_dataframe.xlsx"))

### Stats

### Survival: 


aov_shift_Survival <- aov(data = Survival_Mesocosm_Mucoid_NoIn, Percentage_Dry_ave ~ Treatment*Timepoint)
aov_shift_Survival
anova_shift_Survival_mucoid <- anova(aov_shift_Survival) ## There is no effect of the timpoint per se but there is an Treatment:Timepoint effect probably driven by Time. 

aov_shift_table <- rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(anova_shift_Survival_mucoid), var = "Term")

shift_Survival_table <- aov_shift_table %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & !matches("^Df$"), ~ sprintf("%.3f", .))) %>%
  mutate(`Pr(>F)` = ifelse(as.numeric(`Pr(>F)`) < 0.001, "< 0.001", `Pr(>F)`)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-`Mean Sq`)

shift_Survival_table


### Tukey Temperature: changes across timepoints 

Tukey_shift_survival_all <- c("32 °C", "22 °C", "4 °C", "Drought") %>%
  map_dfr(~ {
    aov_model <- aov(Percentage_Dry_ave ~ Timepoint,
                     data = Survival_Mesocosm_Mucoid_NoIn %>% filter(Treatment == .x))
    
    TukeyHSD(aov_model)$Timepoint %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      rownames_to_column("Comparison") %>%
      as_tibble() %>%
      mutate(Treatment = .x)
  }) %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(diff, lwr, upr), ~ sprintf("%.3f", .)),
    `p adj` = ifelse(`p adj` < 0.001, "< 0.001", sprintf("%.3f", `p adj`))
  ) %>%
  select(Treatment, Comparison, diff, `p adj`)

Tukey_shift_survival_all

write_xlsx(Tukey_shift_survival_all, here("Tables", "Table_Survival_FromR.xlsx"))

## Comparing plant traits and fitness traits with mucosity calculated

### Arrange the plant trait file starting with plant harvesting and then rhizobial relative fitness

```{r}

## PLANT TRAITS

### Create the column nodule number, and from the single cell data I also have the CFU/area of nodule to determine the density of rhizobial released. 

MasterSpreadsheet_AVT_Single_strain_exp <- read_excel("~/OneDrive - The Pennsylvania State University/Burghardt Lab Shared Folder/Projects/NIFA-AVT-AlfalfaProjects/Aim3AVT_SingleInoculationExp/_MasterSpreadsheet_AVT_Single_strain_exp.xlsx", sheet = 2)
#View(MasterSpreadsheet_AVT_Single_strain_exp)
MasterSpreadsheet_AVT_Single_strain_exp <- MasterSpreadsheet_AVT_Single_strain_exp %>%  
  filter(!is.na(Morphology)) %>% ##Filter out the mixtures and the strains that were not characterized (probably commercial inoculum)
  mutate(Nod_number = as.numeric(Nodule_LOBED) + as.numeric(Nodule_UN_Lobed),
         Prop_branched = as.numeric(Nodule_LOBED)/Nod_number)

MasterSpreadsheet_AVT_Single_strain_exp <- MasterSpreadsheet_AVT_Single_strain_exp %>% 
  select(c(Strain, Variety, Morphology, Shootweight_g, Rootweight_g, Nod_number, Prop_branched)) ## Remove traits not important for this analysis

MasterSpreadsheet_AVT_Single_strain_exp_ave <- 
  MasterSpreadsheet_AVT_Single_strain_exp %>%
  group_by(Strain, Variety, Morphology) %>%
  summarise(
    ave_shoot = mean(as.numeric(Shootweight_g), na.rm = TRUE),
    ave_root  = mean(as.numeric(Rootweight_g), na.rm = TRUE),
    ave_nod_total = mean(Nod_number, na.rm = TRUE),
    ave_prop_branched = mean(Prop_branched, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


## RHIZOBIA RELATIVE FITNESS 

## I will import the file that Sohini sent me that has the information about the strains. 

StrainFitness_Plants <- read.table("/Users/mariaalejandragilpolo/Downloads/Strain Fitness_AVTSS_pangenome.txt", header = TRUE, sep = "")
#View(StrainFitness_Plants)
# This data set includes MC2 and also MIX. I think the one I need to use is MIX. Not MC2. I think MC2 has the extra commercial strains. 
# I do not like the way the name of the strains are stored because it does not match the name I am giving htem so i will change that

StrainFitness_Plants <- StrainFitness_Plants %>% 
  separate(col = pool, 
           into = c("AG", "Type", "Variety", "Rep"), ## Type has MIX or MC2. I need to filter out MC2
           sep = "_", 
           remove = FALSE, 
           fill = "right"
  )

## There are some that have a -Inf so I will replace it with -8

StrainFitness_Plants <- StrainFitness_Plants %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(. == -Inf, -8, .))) 


#View(StrainFitness_Plants)
## Filter out MC2 and only keep MIX values 

StrainFitness_Plants <- StrainFitness_Plants %>% filter(Type == "MIX")

### I will shift this so that I have the colnames as rownames. I want a pivot longer

StrainFitness_Plants_long <- StrainFitness_Plants %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Variety,Rep,pool, AG, Type, Variety, Rep),                    
    names_to = "Strain_Code",       
    values_to = "Fitness"            
  )

#View(StrainFitness_Plants_long)
#
Codes <- read_excel("/Users/mariaalejandragilpolo/Downloads/Strain_codes_Edited.xlsx")
#View(Codes)
### Now merge the files that they contain the same "Strain_Code"

StrainFitness_Plant <- merge(StrainFitness_Plants_long, Codes, by = "Strain_Code") ## This could be a Data_input for rhizobial fitness
#View(StrainFitness_Plant)

write_xlsx(StrainFitness_Plant, here("Data_input", "Strain_fitness_Plant_FromR.xlsx")) ## This could be a Data_input for rhizobial with the raw MIX data for rhizobial fitness (Filtered out MC2 here for this table)


### Now I will make the like boxplots. Average and put it somewhere??

StrainFitness_Plant_ave <- StrainFitness_Plant %>% 
  group_by(Strain, Variety, Morphology) %>%
  summarise(Fitness_ave = mean(Fitness))

View(StrainFitness_Plant_ave)

write_xlsx(StrainFitness_Plant_ave, here("Data_input", "Strain_fitness_Plant_FromR.xlsx"))


## Plant trait and Anthone quantification

Shoot_OD_ave <- merge(MasterSpreadsheet_AVT_Single_strain_exp_ave, Anthrone_mean %>% select(-"Morphology"), by = "Strain")# Remove Morphology to avoid duplication of columns
#View(Shoot_OD_ave)

Shoot_OD_ave <- Shoot_OD_ave %>% select(Strain, Variety, Glucose_OD600_ave, ave_shoot, Morphology)
#View(Shoot_OD_ave)

Shoot_OD_ave_NoOutliers <- Shoot_OD_ave %>% filter(!Strain %in% c("121", "018")) %>% select(-"Morphology") ## Removin

#View(StrainFitness_Plant_ave)

### Merge this data with StrainFitness_Plant_ave

StrainFitness_Plant_ave_NoOutliers <- StrainFitness_Plant_ave %>% filter(!Strain %in% c("121", "018", "067")) ## Removin
StrainFitness_Plant_ave_NoOutliers

Shoot_fitness_OD_ave_NoOutliers <- merge(Shoot_OD_ave_NoOutliers, StrainFitness_Plant_ave_NoOutliers, by = c("Strain","Variety"))

### Co-ocurrence

I have made a table that has the number of nodules that I harvested per pair, and it also has the % of mucoid, dry and mixture. I also have the barplots in this code. The Data_input is added as well. 

```{r setup, include=FALSE}

Individual_nodule_data <- read_excel(here("Data_input/Single_nodule_data.xlsx"))
unique(Individual_nodule_data$Morphology)
Individual_nodule_data <- Individual_nodule_data %>% filter(Morphology %in% c("Dry", "Mucoid", "Mixture")) #Remove contaminants and morphologies that did not have a clear morphology
#View(Individual_nodule_data)
### Create a table that shows the proportions of each morphology in the nodules 

function_pair <- function(Partner) {c(
  Name = Partner, 
  nrow(Individual_nodule_data %>% filter(Name == Partner)),
  sprintf("%.3f", 100*nrow(Individual_nodule_data %>% filter(Name == Partner & Morphology == "Mucoid"))/nrow(Individual_nodule_data %>% filter(Name == Partner))),
  sprintf("%.3f", 100*nrow(Individual_nodule_data %>% filter(Name == Partner & Morphology == "Dry"))/nrow(Individual_nodule_data %>% filter(Name == Partner))),
  sprintf("%.3f", 100*nrow(Individual_nodule_data %>% filter(Name == Partner & Morphology == "Mixture"))/nrow(Individual_nodule_data %>% filter(Name == Partner))))
}

#unique(Individual_nodule_data$Name)
Table_mix_percentage <- rbind(function_pair("091_101"), function_pair("015_099"), function_pair("016_100"), function_pair("029_098"))
Table_mix_percentage <- as.data.frame(Table_mix_percentage)
Table_mix_percentage

colnames(Table_mix_percentage) <- c("Pair", "Number of nodules", "% Mucoid", "% Dry", "% Mixture")

Table_mix_percentage

write_xlsx(Table_mix_percentage, here("Tables/TableA_FromR.xlsx"))

## Total number of nodules with mixture and with single 

## Total of nodules with valid assessment (taking out the contaminations). The results suggest that from 225 nodules, 83% have a single morphology, either mucoid or dry, wherease mixtures occupy around 17% of the nodules. The data broken down is in the upper part. 

Total_nod_number <- nrow(Individual_nodule_data)
Total_nod_number #225 from an initial of 70*4 = 280


percentage_mixture <- nrow(Individual_nodule_data %>% filter(Morphology == "Mixture"))/nrow(Individual_nodule_data)*100
percentage_mixture #16.889
percentage_single <- nrow(Individual_nodule_data %>% filter(Morphology %in% c("Mucoid", "Dry")))/nrow(Individual_nodule_data)*100
percentage_single #83.111



## Plot

color_values <- c("Mucoid" = "#4eadb9",
                  "Dry" = "#e0ba3e",
                  "Mixture" = "#97b47c")

coocurrence <- ggplot(Individual_nodule_data, 
       aes(x = Name, 
           fill = Morphology)) + 
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_values)+
  labs(x = "Pair", y = "Proportion")+
  theme(axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 14)) +
  theme_bw()

coocurrence

ggsave(coocurrence, 
       filename = here("Figures" ,"coocurrence.pdf"),
       device = "pdf",
       height = 4, width = 6, units = "in")

  mutate(`Pr(>Chi)` = ifelse(as.numeric(`Pr(>Chi)`) < 0.001, "< 0.001", `Pr(>Chi)`))

write_xlsx(anova6_Table, "TableS6_FromR.xlsx")


summary(model6)
emm <- emmeans(model6, ~ Timepoint | Treatment, type = "response")
pairs(emm, adjust = "holm") 




### For growth

model7 <- glm(cbind(Dry_CFU_Total_ave, Mucoid_CFU_Total_ave) ~ Treatment * Timepoint,
    data = Growth_Mesocoms_Mixture_ave.expanded, family = binomial)
summary(model7)
anova7 <- anova(model7)
anova7

anova7 <- rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(anova7), var = "Term")


anova7_Table<- anova7 %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & !matches("^Df$"), ~ sprintf("%.3f", .))) %>%
  mutate(`Pr(>Chi)` = ifelse(as.numeric(`Pr(>Chi)`) < 0.001, "< 0.001", `Pr(>Chi)`))
#  dplyr::select(-`Mean Sq`)

write_xlsx(anova7_Table, "TableS7_FromR.xlsx")



emm <- emmeans(model7, ~ Timepoint | Treatment, type = "response")
pairs(emm, adjust = "holm")
